The three stations are close together and their catchments overlap heavily; count each institution only once. Return the count.

code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# First, verify the stations are roadside stations
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, station_type
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id IN (14, 16, 17)
""")
stations = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(stations)

# Now count distinct EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION sensitive areas within 5000m of any of these stations
query = text("""
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sa.id) as count
FROM sensitive_area sa
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON ST_DWithin(
    ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography,
    aqs.coordinate::geography,
    5000
)
WHERE sa.category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'
AND aqs.id IN (14, 16, 17)
""")
result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)
schools_roadside_5km = int(result['count'].values[0])
print(f"Final count: {schools_roadside_5km}")
